what: When the section head touches the top of the screen it is pinned, and while scrolling by (strip width − screen width) the strip is pushed left by that amount (no curve, tied directly to scroll). Large photo and video cells inside the strip grow from .7 to 1 (scrub 1) while their left edge moves from the right edge of the screen to the center, so they come into focus as if approaching — a lodging first page that scrolls three sections like rooms, dining, and hot spring as one scroll. Below 820px the strip stacks vertically and doesn’t move

options.[data-fx-part=track]: Strip that flows horizontally (inside the section, required) — put 100vw spacing before the first cell and after the last, and like the original it enters from an empty screen and exits to an empty screen
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Cells to enlarge (inside the strip, multiple)
options.scrub: Delay for the band following scroll (s), default true (immediate)
options.media-scrub: Delay before the cell grows (s), default 1
options.media-start: Position (horizontal) where the cell starts to grow, default left 100%
options.media-end: Position where it grows fully, default left 50%
options.min: Minimum width (px) for horizontal flow, default 820

from.where: index.html .kh-side (original top.js — js-side-scroll-wrap x: -(scrollWidth − clientWidth) ease none, start top top, end scrollWidth − innerWidth, pin, scrub true, anticipatePin 1 · js-side-scroll-mainimg from scale .7, containerAnimation, left 100% → left 50%, scrub 1 · 820px and up)
